evd_title: GAR achieved F1 score of 0.66 on ICLR 23 paper acceptance prediction significantly exceeding human baseline of 0.49
finding: GAR achieved F1 score of 0.66 on ICLR 23 paper acceptance prediction significantly exceeding human baseline of 0.49
P: 1,000 papers each from NeurIPS 2023, ICLR 2022, ICLR 2023 (OpenReview); official accept/reject decisions as ground truth
I: GAR multi-agent reviewer + meta-reviewer (and GAR> score-threshold 6 variant), GPT-4o-mini backbone; 20 runs
C: Human F1 0.49 (NeurIPS consistency study); AI-Scientist, OpenReviewer, ReviewerGPT, AI-Review; random, always-reject
O: Acceptance F1 NeurIPS/ICLR22/ICLR23: GAR 0.61/0.66/0.60; GAR> 0.62/0.67/0.69; AI-Scientist 0.51/0.57/0.55; human 0.49 (PDF Table 3)
T: NeurIPS 2023, ICLR 2022, ICLR 2023 submissions; run dates not reported; paper 2024
